verdict.rationale: Kintsugi documents bulk ingestion: CSV file upload imports many sales transactions at once for onboarding or backfill, and prebuilt connectors keep transactions in sync continuously. Beyond that, the API evidence shows single-record create endpoints and paginated list reads, with no batch mutation capability. Missing for 10: bulk update/delete or batch API endpoints, bulk operations on non-transaction items (exemptions, registrations, products), agent-driven bulk actions (the MCP server only reads docs and does not call the API), and independent corroboration.
